T: Melbourne, sunshine and a very big Greek feed.
D: A carefree Greek-Australian bloke from Sydney accidentally becomes a TV star.
P: Serve the mains when Derryn Hinch outs Steve as Australia's worst dole bludger.
S: Spinach wilted and squeezed dry, mixed with feta, ricotta, dill, spring onion and egg, wrapped in buttered filo triangles, baked at 190C for 25 minutes.
kefalograviera floured and fried crusty, flamed with brandy at the table, lemon, honey, oregano

Kefalograviera dusted in flour and fried in olive oil until crusty, flamed at the table with a splash of brandy, then hit with lemon, honey and oregano. Cut 400g kefalograviera or haloumi into 2cm thick slabs, wet with water and dust in plain flour. Fry in 3 tbsp hot olive oil for 2 minutes a side until a deep golden crust forms. Move the pan to the table on a board, pour over 30ml warmed brandy and carefully light it, standing back. When the flame dies, squeeze over a lemon, drizzle with 1 tbsp honey and sprinkle with dried oregano. Serve with warm pita.
Get tzatziki with it, taramasalata and warm pita
grated cucumber, yoghurt, garlic and dill, creamy fish roe dip, olives and soft flatbread
Tzatziki of grated cucumber, yoghurt, garlic and dill, and taramasalata, with warm pita and olives.
M: Karamitsis family lamb on the spit
Lemon and oregano lamb. Not a plaster lion.

Lamb shoulder rubbed with lemon, garlic, oregano and olive oil, roasted at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart, with lemon potatoes roasted in the juices. Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart. Add 1kg potato wedges to the pan for the last 90 minutes so they soak up the juices, then uncover to brown.
Pork souvlaki wraps with chips inside
lemon oregano skewers in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and hot salty chips, rolled tight

Lemon and oregano pork skewers charred hot, wrapped in warm pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion and a handful of salty chips inside, Sydney late-night style. Marinate 800g diced pork shoulder in 4 tbsp olive oil, the juice of 2 lemons, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano and salt for 2 hours. Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 10 to 12 minutes, turning. Bake 400g frozen chips at 220C for 20 minutes and salt well. Warm 4 large pita breads, spread with tzatziki and fill with pork, sliced tomato, red onion, parsley and chips, then roll tight in paper.
W: Honey puffs with walnuts, the bingo thank you
Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil at 175C, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey syrup with cinnamon and walnuts.
K: Greek coffee, slow in a small pot
Finely ground coffee boiled in a small pot with water and sugar until it foams, poured into small cups, grounds left to settle.

steps.text: Heat the oven to 190C. Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and chop.
Mix with the feta, ricotta, dill, spring onion and egg.
Cut buttered filo into strips, add filling and fold into triangles.
Brush with butter and bake.

Mix into the yoghurt with the garlic, dill and salt.
Spoon into a bowl beside the taramasalata.
Warm the pita in the oven and cut into wedges.

Roast covered at 150C.

veg.n: Karamitsis family lemon and oregano eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Score and rub the eggplants up to 1 day ahead, covered in the fridge; roast on the night and crumble over the feta at the end

steps.text: Score the cut sides of the eggplants deeply and rub with the lemon juice, garlic, oregano, most of the oil and the salt.
Roast at 180C with the potato wedges tossed in the rest of the oil, covered for the first 30 minutes.
Uncover, scatter the chickpeas around and roast until everything is browned.
Crumble the feta over and serve.
Mix the flour, yeast and water into a sticky batter and rest until bubbly.
Warm the honey with the water and cinnamon for the syrup.
Heat the oil to 175C.
Drop in spoonfuls of batter and fry until puffed and golden.
Toss in warm syrup and scatter with walnuts.
Put the coffee, sugar and water in a small pot.
Heat slowly, stirring once, until it foams up to the rim.
Pour into small cups and let the grounds settle before sipping.

Karamitsis family lamb on the spit.veg: Lemon, garlic and oregano eggplant roasted until soft, potato wedges and chickpeas in the juices

s.how: Wilt 500g spinach, squeeze dry and chop. Mix with 200g crumbled feta, 200g ricotta, chopped dill, spring onion and an egg. Cut buttered filo into strips, spoon filling at one end and fold into triangles. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

s.n: Get tzatziki with it, taramasalata and warm pita
s.how: Grate a Lebanese cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix into 500g Greek yoghurt with crushed garlic, chopped dill and salt. Spoon into a bowl beside a tub of taramasalata. Warm pita bread in the oven, cut into wedges and serve with a bowl of olives.

m.n: Karamitsis family lamb on the spit
m.note: Lemon and oregano lamb. Not a plaster lion.
m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with lemon juice, crushed garlic, oregano, olive oil and salt. Roast covered at 150C for 5 hours until it falls apart. Add 1kg potato wedges to the pan for the last 90 minutes so they soak up the juices, then uncover to brown.

w.note: Honey puffs with walnuts, the bingo thank you
w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water into a sticky batter and rest an hour until bubbly. Drop spoonfuls into 175C oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in warm honey syrup with cinnamon and scatter with chopped walnuts. Eat while warm.

d.note: Greek coffee, slow in a small pot
d.how: For each cup, put a heaped teaspoon of very finely ground coffee, sugar to taste and a small cup of cold water into a small pot. Heat slowly, stirring once, until it foams up to the rim. Pour into small cups and let the grounds settle before sipping.
